fee_notes: Royalty is 10% of monthly Gross Receipts; beginning month 24, greater of 10% or $1,500/month. Base royalty $650/month (begins 6 months after signing, single fee for all centers unless Base Royalty Acquisition). Marketing fee is $250 flat + 2% of Gross Receipts. Separate Digital and Local Marketing Fee minimum $1,000/month (begins 2 months pre-opening). CPI escalator applies to fixed-dollar fees annually up to 3%.
raw_excerpt: Monthly Royalty: Initially, 10% of your monthly Gross Receipts... Beginning in the 24th month of operation of the Center, the greater of (i) the 10% monthly royalty or (ii) $1,500. Monthly Marketing Fee: $250 plus 2% of your monthly Gross Receipts. Technology License Fee: Currently, $266 per month per Mathnasium Center.
